node.statement: The saturated diagonal c2(1,1,2) source-line literal registry is complete. The aligned-positive unramified registry has 36 semantic cells and is PROVED by a disjoint seven-packet census. In the affine near-positive branch, two exact restricted q-slice transports reduce 108 semantic literal cells to 42 orbits: 12 contain the canonical F00/M00 systems and all 30 direct representatives are excluded, with finite survivors rejected by direct first-quotient replay. A separate compiler proves all 48 literal positive projective-boundary cells q-slice empty. Direct two-chart reconstruction proves all twelve aligned-negative assignments empty across 32 genuine consistency components. Finally, the negative residual constant identity reduces all 48 near-negative assignment/root cells to 64 specialized consistency components, all unit under two exact localization formulations. Thus every literal cell is classified without generic endpoint covariance.
